dedupe_keys.name: rfnsa radio frequency national site archive australian mobile base stations

description: The RFNSA is the Australian archive of mobile network base stations, searchable by keyword, address, postcode or place name. Contents: for each existing or proposed mobile site the site number, address, network operators, active or proposed technologies, a map location, the compliance certificate and electromagnetic energy (EME) report, carrier contacts for emergencies, site access and general enquiries, and community consultation details for new sites or upgrades. Producer: AMTA, managing the site for the Mobile Carriers Forum. Coverage: Australia. Access: a public search interface with a map and email subscriptions by postcode; no bulk download was seen and the terms and conditions must be accepted. Licence and cost: free to search; usage is bound by the RFNSA terms and conditions, whose reuse clauses were not read. Caveats: the page shows site attributes but no coverage or traffic data, and automated extraction may conflict with the terms. Simulation uses: it locates mobile sites and technologies, which supports network resilience, capacity planning and exposure analysis of cell sites to hazards. Related record: the ACCC broadband measurement data (data-accc-measuring-broadband-australia).
